field.search.label: Search the archive
field.search.placeholder: A word, a phrase, an idea
system.title: Design system
system.subtitle: Every token, type style and primitive in both themes
system.ruler.intro: Touch targets are 30mm, not the 44px web convention. Calibrate against a bank card, which is 85.60mm wide by international standard.
citation.inferred.explain: This page number was inferred from the surrounding sequence, not read off the page.
twin.canvas.label: A three dimensional model of the Dr. Ambedkar International Centre with thirteen interactive devices
kiosk.pending: This room opens in step {step} of the build.
kiosk.loading: Opening the archive on this device
channel.entrance.about: Choose a language, take a card, and find your way through the Centre.
channel.reading.about: Search the writings and the Assembly debates, and read every passage where it was printed.
channel.provenance.about: Trace an Article of the Constitution back through the Assembly debate to the words that began it.
channel.timeline.about: A life, year by year, in documents and photographs.
channel.manuscript.about: Pages of the archive under magnification, with their transcription beside them.
channel.audio.about: Any passage, read aloud, in the language you choose.
channel.av.about: Lectures, documentaries and interviews, searchable to the second a phrase is spoken.
channel.assistant.about: Ask about the works and the Constitution. Every answer cites its page.
channel.curator.about: Ingest, correction and the state of every device in the hall.
reading.abstract.editor: Sentences chosen by an editor from this section, each with its page.
reading.abstract.machine: Sentences chosen by machine from this section, each with its page. Nothing is reworded.
reading.failed: This page could not be opened on this kiosk.
dossier.title: Kept ({count})
dossier.empty: Nothing kept yet. Hold your finger on a passage to choose it, then press Keep.
dossier.qr.title: Take it home
dossier.qr.label: A code for the passages you kept ({count})
dossier.qr.caption: Scan with a phone. The code holds page references only, nothing about you.
dossier.onCard: Also on your card, at every kiosk you tap it.
dossier.noCard: Without a card this stays here only while you do.
takehome.place: Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, 15 Janpath, New Delhi
takehome.title: What you kept
takehome.loading: Finding your passages in the archive
takehome.missing: Passages in this link that could not be found in this edition of the archive: {count}.
takehome.note: Every passage is as printed, with the volume and page it comes from.
entrance.take.title: Take a card
entrance.take: Take a card from the bowl and hold it to the reader. It will carry these choices to every kiosk in the hall.
entrance.ready.title: Your card is ready
entrance.ready: Every kiosk you tap it at will open in {language}. Text size: {size}.
entrance.noReader.title: No card reader here
entrance.noReader: Your choices hold at this kiosk for as long as you stay. Every kiosk has the same choices behind its language button.
entrance.leaving.title: Before you go
entrance.leaving: Passages kept on your card: {count}. Scan the code to take them home.
entrance.return: Then return the card to the bowl. Returning it erases what it held.
